name: references
description: Find all cross-file references to a symbol (call targets, imports, extends). NOTE: searches by target_name stored in refs table — for member expressions like spawn.spawnFixer, search "spawn.spawnFixer" not just "spawnFixer". For best results, first use symbol_search to confirm the exact symbol name, then search references. REQUIRED: Call reindex first if this is a new workspace.

workspace_dir.description: REQUIRED: Absolute path to the project root directory. Call reindex first if this is a new workspace.

symbol.description: Symbol name / call target to find references for

file.description: Restrict search to a specific file (path relative to workspace root, e.g. "scripts/lib/tools/spawn.mjs")
